description: This build script defines a custom Gradle task 'LintForwardTask' that forwards lint checks to the ':app:lint' task. It sets up a root-level 'lint' task for the project, primarily for CI integration, delegating the actual linting to the app module.

classes.name: LintForwardTask
classes.description: A custom Gradle task that inherits from DefaultTask, used to forward lint checks to the ':app:lint' task.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: The task action method that is invoked when the 'lint' task runs. It currently performs no operation.
